home.cashWeatherHint: Tap a day to see details

insight.billsWeekBody: {count} bills totalling {amount} in the next 7 days.

spend.title: Can I spend this?
spend.subtitle: Check a one-off expense against your next 30 days.
spend.invalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
spend.resultSafe: Yes — your lowest balance stays at {amount}, above your reserve.
spend.resultNear: Careful — your lowest balance drops to {amount}, under your reserve.
spend.resultBelow: Not now — you would go below zero by {amount}.
spend.needsForecast: A spending check needs forecast data. Connect your forecast engine or explore the demo.
spend.dateInvalid: Choose a date within the next 30 days.
spend.bodySafe: Your lowest balance stays at {amount} on {date} — {margin} above your reserve.
spend.bodyRisky: Your lowest balance drops to {amount} on {date} — {margin} under your {reserve} reserve.
spend.bodyNotNow: Your balance would fall to {amount} on {date}. You would be {short} short.
spend.saferDate: A safer date: {date}. Your lowest balance would then be {amount} ({verdict}).
spend.noSaferDate: No safer date in the next 30 days. Consider chasing customer payments first.
spend.previewNote: Preview only — your forecast is unchanged.

profile.title: Profile
profile.privacyBody: Your language choice is stored only on this device.

placeholder.body: This screen is being built. Your Home screen and settings are ready to use.

forecast.title: Forecast
forecast.subtitle: Your next 30 days, based on scheduled money in and out.
forecast.chartHint: Tap a day on the chart, or use the arrow keys, to see what happens.
forecast.chartSummary: Balance goes from {start} to {end}. Lowest is {lowest} on {date}.
forecast.dayFlat: No money moves on this day.
forecast.noWarnings: No warnings. Your balance stays above your reserve for the next 30 days.
forecast.scenarioNote: Showing the “{name}” scenario selected on Home.
forecast.whatIfAppliedBody: These numbers include your what-if changes. They are temporary and not saved to your forecast.
forecast.demoLabel: Demo figures — not your real account.
forecast.emptyBody: Your forecast engine is not connected yet, so there are no real figures to show. You can explore with demo data.
forecast.partialRange: Only {count} days of forecast are available. This is not a full 30-day view.
forecast.noCrossings: Stays above your reserve for the whole period.

warning.belowZeroBody: Projected balance {balance}. You would be short by {gap}.
warning.belowReserveTitle: Balance drops under your reserve on {date}
warning.actionReviewSupplier: Check if the {party} payment on {date} can move later
warning.actionHoldSpending: Hold off on non-essential spending until then
warning.gapNoReserve: No reserve is set, so only below-zero risks were checked.
warning.gapShortHorizon: The forecast covers fewer than 30 days, so later risks may be missing.
warning.gapNoInflowData: No expected payments are recorded, so incoming money isn't counted.

whatIf.title: What-if
whatIf.subtitle: Describe a change and preview its effect. Nothing is saved to your forecast.
whatIf.inputHint: Rule-based, not AI: mention customer, supplier, rent, salary, tax or a name, plus a number of days or an amount.
whatIf.placeholder: e.g. A customer pays 7 days late
whatIf.voiceNote: Voice input isn't available yet — please type.
whatIf.changesEmpty: Describe a change above or pick an example.
whatIf.affectsNone: No matching items in the next 30 days
whatIf.unrecognised: We couldn't read “{text}”. Name a customer, supplier, rent, salary or tax with a number of days, or an expense with an amount.
whatIf.stale: You changed the scenario. Preview again to update the result.
whatIf.assumptionEngine: Uses the same rule as your forecast: each day adds money in and subtracts money out.
whatIf.assumptionCategory: “{category}” applies to every matching item in the next 30 days. Type a name to target one.
whatIf.assumptionParty: Applies to every scheduled item for {party}.
whatIf.assumptionExpenseDate: The {amount} is placed on {date}. Add “in 5 days” to choose another day.
whatIf.assumptionOutOfRange: {count} items move past the 30-day window and are left out.
whatIf.assumptionNoMatch: {label} matches nothing scheduled, so it has no effect.
whatIf.applied: Applied for this session — not saved. It shows on Forecast until you remove it or reload.
whatIf.needsForecast: What-if needs forecast data. Connect your forecast engine or explore the demo.
whatIf.example5: Move my ₹5,000 payment to next Friday
whatIf.example7: Move my ₹45,000 rent to next Friday
whatIf.inputHintV2: Rule-based, not AI. Mention an amount, a name or a type (customer, supplier, rent, salary, tax) and when — e.g. tomorrow, next Friday, in 5 days, 7 days late.
whatIf.emptyInput: Type a change first, or pick an example.
whatIf.parseFailed: We couldn't read that. Try rephrasing, or add a change yourself below.
whatIf.duplicates: Some of these changes were already in your plan, so they weren't added twice.
whatIf.nothingNew: We didn't find a new change in that sentence.
whatIf.parsedHint: Check and edit these before you preview. Nothing changes until you apply.
whatIf.errAmountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
whatIf.errAmountTooLarge: That amount looks too large. Please check it.
whatIf.errDaysInvalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to {max}.
whatIf.hintNoMatch: No {amount} item is scheduled in the next 30 days. Choose the payment you meant.
whatIf.hintNoMatchGeneric: We couldn't find that payment. Choose the one you meant.
whatIf.hintMultiple: {count} items match. We picked the earliest — check it's the one you meant.
whatIf.warnNoMatch: Nothing scheduled matches this, so it has no effect.
whatIf.warnSameDate: This payment is already on that date, so nothing changes.
whatIf.fixIssues: Fix the highlighted fields before previewing.
whatIf.previewPlaceholderBody: Describe a change, check the fields, then preview. Your original forecast never changes.
whatIf.reserveSame: No change to your reserve margin.
whatIf.previewOnly: Preview only — your original forecast is unchanged.
whatIf.appliedBody: {count} change(s) applied. Kept in memory on this device only — not saved, and cleared when you reload.
whatIf.appliedLimit: Home and Forecast still show your original forecast.
whatIf.includesApplied: Your plan starts with the changes you already applied. Applying again replaces them, so nothing is counted twice.
whatIf.resetLabel: Reset: clear the plan and remove the applied what-if
whatIf.announceReset: Reset. You're back to the original forecast.
whatIf.baseNote: The planner always starts from the base forecast, not the scenario chips on Home.
whatIf.engineNotConnected: The live forecast engine isn't connected yet, so there are no real figures. You can try the planner with demo data.
whatIf.demoNote: Sample figures, not your real account.
whatIf.chartLabel: Original lowest {before} on {beforeDate}. With your plan, lowest {after} on {afterDate}.
whatIf.movedOut: {count} item(s) move past the 30-day window and are left out.
whatIf.engineShort: The live forecast engine isn't connected yet.

bills.title: Bills
bills.subtitle: Scheduled money going out in your forecast.
bills.emptyAll: No outgoing payments are scheduled in this forecast.
bills.emptyOverdue: No overdue payments. The forecast only lists payments from today onwards.
bills.readOnly: Read-only list from your forecast. Nothing here is paid or changed.

receivables.emptyAll: No incoming payments are recorded in this forecast.
receivables.emptyExpected: No payments expected from today onwards.
receivables.emptyOverdue: No overdue payments. Every customer is on time.
receivables.readOnly: List from your forecast. Payments you mark as Received in Chase are excluded from the outstanding total.

chase.note: Overdue payments and those due within 7 days. Captidict does not contact anyone for you.
chase.sessionNote: Follow-up status is kept on this device for this session only and clears when you reload.
chase.receivedNote: “Received” is a session-only note: it lowers the outstanding total here but does not change your forecast or bank balance.

export.heading: Export
export.pdfOpened: Print dialog opened. Choose “Save as PDF” to keep a copy.
export.pdfBlocked: The print dialog couldn't open here. Download the printable report and print it from your browser.
export.empty: There's nothing to export in this view.
export.pdfHelp: PDF uses your browser’s print dialog — choose “Save as PDF”. CSV opens in Excel or Google Sheets.
export.demoNote: DEMO DATA — sample figures, not a real account.
export.planNote: Includes what-if changes applied for this session only.
export.closingNote: Closing balance is the end-of-day balance after every item on that date.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.subtitle: Early warnings from your forecast, most urgent first.
warnings.rule: Urgent: balance below zero. Warning: under your {reserve} reserve within 7 days. Heads up: later reserve dips and overdue customer payments.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.subtitle: Record money coming in and going out of your business.
transactions.formSubtitle: Notes are optional. Everything else is required.
transactions.notesPlaceholder: Anything to remember about this entry
transactions.errAmountLarge: That amount looks too large. Please check it.
transactions.errDateFar: Choose a date within the next year.
transactions.deleteBody: “{title}” for {amount} will be removed. This can’t be undone.
transactions.emptyBody: Add your first income or expense to start your history.
transactions.forecastOn: Entries dated {start} – {end} are included in your forecast, warnings and spending check. Earlier entries are history only.
transactions.forecastOff: No forecast is connected yet, so these entries are not part of any forecast.
transactions.sessionNote: Entries are kept for this session only. They are not saved to your device or sent anywhere.
transactions.demoNote: Rows marked Demo are sample records, not your real transactions. Anything you add here stays in the demo and is cleared when you exit demo mode.
